deskripsi: Latihan verbal dan bacaan bahasa Inggris: synonym, antonym, verbal analogy, word classification, logical reasoning, different word, idiom, iklan, dialog, recount text, dan kartu ucapan.

soal.soal: Verdict : ...
soal.penjelasan: Verdict (putusan) bersinonim dengan decision.

soal.soal: Pledge : ....
soal.penjelasan: Pledge (janji) bersinonim dengan promise.

soal.soal: Dissuade : ....
soal.penjelasan: Dissuade (membujuk agar tidak melakukan) paling dekat dengan prevent (mencegah).

soal.soal: Industrious : ....
soal.penjelasan: Industrious (rajin) bersinonim dengan diligent.

soal.soal: Idle : ....
soal.penjelasan: Idle (menganggur) paling dekat dengan unproductive (tidak produktif).

soal.soal: Reckless : .....
soal.penjelasan: Pada bagian antonim: lawan kata reckless (ceroboh) adalah prudent (hati-hati).

soal.soal: Content : .....
soal.penjelasan: Pada bagian antonim: lawan kata content (puas, bahagia) adalah miserable (sengsara).

soal.soal: Reluctant : .....
soal.penjelasan: Pada bagian antonim: lawan kata reluctant (enggan) adalah eager (bersemangat).

soal.soal: Commend : ....
soal.penjelasan: Pada bagian antonim: lawan kata commend (memuji) adalah blame (menyalahkan).

soal.soal: Contentment : ......
soal.penjelasan: Pada bagian antonim: lawan kata contentment (kepuasan, kenyamanan) adalah discomfort (ketidaknyamanan).

soal.soal: Chef : Kitchen = Mechanic :...
soal.penjelasan: Koki bekerja di dapur; montir bekerja di bengkel (profesi : tempat kerja).

soal.soal: Lion : Brave = Owl : ....
soal.penjelasan: Singa identik dengan berani; burung hantu identik dengan cerdas.

soal.soal: Clock : Time = Thermometer : ...
soal.penjelasan: Jam mengukur waktu; termometer mengukur suhu (temperature).

soal.soal: Wheel : Car = Wing : ...
soal.penjelasan: Roda adalah bagian mobil; sayap adalah bagian pesawat.

soal.soal: Student : Study = Athlete : ...
soal.penjelasan: Siswa belajar (study) untuk berkembang; atlet berlatih (train).

soal.soal: Which one is an adverb below?
soal.penjelasan: Harmful, tired, dan famous adalah kata sifat; slowly adalah adverb. Pada buku, kata 'not' pada soal dicoret, sehingga soal dibaca 'Which one is an adverb'.

soal.soal: One of these words is noun; what is it?
soal.penjelasan: Identity adalah kata benda; identify dan soften (verb), softly (adverb).

soal.soal: Choose the word that function as verb below!
soal.penjelasan: Clarify adalah kata kerja; clarification dan clarity (noun), classic (adjective).

soal.soal: Which word does not belong to the Adverb?
soal.penjelasan: Homeless, poetic, dan flexible adalah kata sifat; upwards adalah adverb.

soal.soal: The following are conjunction, except
soal.penjelasan: Because, although, dan however adalah kata penghubung; behind adalah preposisi.

soal.soal: Lina is shorter than Dira. Dira is taller than Kiki. Kiki is taller than Zaki. Who is the tallest among them?
soal.penjelasan: Urutan tinggi: Dira > Lina dan Dira > Kiki > Zaki, jadi Dira tertinggi.

soal.soal: Andy is older than Bella, but younger than Carla. Dina is younger than Bella. Arrange them from youngest to oldest!
soal.penjelasan: Carla > Andy > Bella > Dina dalam umur; dari termuda: Dina, Bella, Andy, Carla.

soal.soal: Tom runs faster than Jerry. Max runs slower than Jerry. But Jerry runs faster than Sam. Who is the slowest?
soal.penjelasan: Tom > Jerry, Jerry > Max, dan Jerry > Sam; Max dan Sam sama-sama di bawah Jerry sehingga soal ini tidak menentukan yang paling lambat secara tegas. Kata 'But' mengisyaratkan Sam, maka kunci dipilih B. Soal ini dapat ditafsirkan lain (A).

soal.soal: All books in this shelf are fiction. "Harry Potter" is on this shelf. Therefore, "Harry Potter" is...
soal.penjelasan: Semua buku di rak itu fiksi dan Harry Potter ada di rak itu.

soal.soal: If it rains, the ground gets wet. Today, the ground is not wet. Therefore......

pilihan.C: The ground absorbed all the water

soal.penjelasan: Kontraposisi: tanah tidak basah berarti tidak hujan.

soal.soal: Which word is different from the rest?
soal.penjelasan: Elephant, tiger, dan monkey adalah hewan; rose adalah tumbuhan.

soal.soal: Choose the word that is different!
soal.penjelasan: Apple, mango, dan orange adalah buah; tomato umumnya dikelompokkan sebagai sayuran. Soal ini dapat ditafsirkan lain.

soal.soal: Choose the word that is different!
soal.penjelasan: Train, bus, dan bicycle adalah alat transportasi; television bukan.

soal.soal: Which word is the odd one out?
soal.penjelasan: Doctor, pilot, dan police officer adalah profesi; car adalah benda.

soal.soal: Which of the following is NOT like the others?
soal.penjelasan: Cotton, silk, dan plastic adalah bahan; pants (celana) adalah pakaian jadi.

soal.soal:
"Lina was feeling under the weather, so she didn't go to school."
What does the idiom "under the weather" mean?

pilihan.A: She was standing in the rain
pilihan.D: She was sad about the weather

soal.penjelasan: 'Under the weather' berarti merasa tidak enak badan (sakit).

soal.soal:
"After the test, Ali breathed a sigh of relief."
What does "breathed a sigh of relief" mean?

pilihan.D: He didn't want to study anymore

soal.penjelasan: 'Breathed a sigh of relief' berarti merasa lega dan tenang.

soal.soal:
"The math homework was a piece of cake for Nadia."
What does "piece of cake" mean?
soal.penjelasan: 'Piece of cake' berarti sangat mudah.

soal.soal:
"When I forgot my lines on stage, I wished the ground would swallow me up."
What does "swallow me up" mean?

pilihan.C: I wanted to disappear from embarrassment

soal.penjelasan: 'Swallow me up' berarti ingin menghilang karena malu.

soal.soal:
"Dina spilled the beans about the surprise party."
What does "spilled the beans" mean?

pilihan.A: She dropped food on the floor

soal.penjelasan: 'Spilled the beans' berarti membocorkan rahasia.

The text below is for question 36 and 37.

In the advertisement, the text is made for...

pilihan.A: People who want to have a red car
pilihan.B: People who need to buy a car
pilihan.C: Inform the people about car rental services
pilihan.D: To entertain readers with the car's amazing appearance

soal.penjelasan: Iklan Car Rental Services bertujuan memberi informasi tentang layanan sewa mobil.

soal.soal:
The text below is for question 36 and 37.

What is the conclusion of the advertisement?

pilihan.A: You can contact them by following their Instagram
pilihan.B: The cars are not in the good condition
pilihan.C: By renting the cars, you will get a discount and good facilities
pilihan.D: You can visit their website at www.website.co.id.

soal.penjelasan: Iklan menawarkan diskon 20% dan fasilitas (interior bersih dan nyaman, AC, diskon pelanggan tetap).

soal.soal:
The text below is for question 38 and 39.

Lina: Hi, Sinta. Can I ask you something?
Sinta: Sure, what is it?
Lina: Can you help me with the English homework? I don't understand question number 5.
Sinta: Of course! Let me see... Oh, this one is about verbs.
Lina: Yes, I get confused with regular and irregular verbs.
Sinta: No problem. I can explain it to you.
Lina: Thank you so much, Sinta!
Sinta: You're welcome. I'm happy to help!

What kind of expression is this?
soal.penjelasan: Lina meminta bantuan ('Can you help me ...?'), jadi ungkapan meminta (requesting).

The text below is for question 40 - 43.

My Trip to the Beach

Last weekend, I went to the beach with my family. We left home early in the morning and brought some food, drinks, and beach toys. The weather was sunny and warm, perfect for a beach day. When we arrived, my brother and I built a big sandcastle. Then, we swam in the sea and played volleyball on the sand. My parents sat under an umbrella and took pictures of us. We had lunch together near the shore and watched the waves. It was a fun and relaxing day. I hope we can visit the beach again next holiday

What is the text about?
soal.penjelasan: Teks menceritakan perjalanan ke pantai.

Dear Anna,

Wish you many happy returns of the day. May God bless you with health, wealth, and prosperity in your life.

HAPPY BIRTHDAY

Love,
Meitha

What does Meitha do for Anindya's birthday party?

pilihan.A: She wishes her many happy returns of the day

soal.penjelasan: Meitha mengucapkan 'many happy returns of the day'. Catatan: di buku ada tulisan tangan pilihan E 'All above' yang bukan bagian cetakan, tidak dimasukkan. Nama penerima di surat adalah Anna, sedangkan soal menyebut Anindya (sesuai cetakan).
